deletion_trials.reason: Removing the replacement reinstates the original conclusion, whose only dependency is x^2≥0; that fact does not establish |x|≥x, so the repair is lost.

reason: For every real x, the absolute-value definition gives |x|=x when x≥0. When x<0, multiplying by −2 gives −2x>0, hence −x>x. Thus |x|≥x in both exhaustive real-number cases. The replacement removes the invalid dependence on x²≥0 without changing the stated theorem, its real-number assumption, or the elementary-algebra domain.
